evidence.text: - Code indexer invariants: one shared `code_files`/`vec_code` pipeline indexes Git-tracked `.rs`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, and `.jsx` files; `crates/daftprompt-indexer/src/code.rs` owns extension-based language dispatch, and production CLI/UI paths must remain language-neutral.
